title: awc-2005-transatlantic
label: The Illustrious Face-Eater

This history follows the write-ups; the crown is not part of the belt's chain. Adam Dick hit Pierce Lavelle with the Shooting Star Press and pinned him, knocking Lavelle's foot off the bottom rope and using the second rope for leverage while the referee missed it, to win the Transatlantic Championship; James Brunt would not announce it.

title: awc-2005-transatlantic

Jack Murphy kicked Aimz off Adam Dick in the middle of a pin, then hit Dick with the Fall From Grace and pinned him to win the Transatlantic Championship at Bloodlust; Dick's crown is not part of the finish. A defence is on record. Fresh!, 7 March 2006: Jack Murphy faked being knocked out on the third drop of the referee's hand, took Mike Wade down with a drop toe hold into the STF, and Wade tapped out, so Murphy retained the Transatlantic Championship.

title: awc-2005-transatlantic

The fed's own title history has no vacancy (Adam Dick from 17 January to 1 September 2006, with Pierce Lavelle's third reign from 1 August concurrent); the write-up has Dick throw the belt down on 4 July 2006 and the belt left vacant. Adam Dick lifted Jack Murphy and dropped him on his head with Murphy's own Fall From Grace and pinned him to win the Transatlantic Championship; James Brunt refused to announce it. Defences on record. Fresh!, 9 May 2006: Adam Dick faked an injury after falling out of the ring, kicked out of Darcy Crisis's pin and hit the Eaterplex '05 to pin him and retain the Transatlantic Championship. Divide And Conquer 2006 (pay-per-view), 23 June 2006: Adam Dick hit Mike Wade with the Finger Poke Of Doom and covered him, and the two Unfuckables embraced after the count; Pearl then sent Michael Ryan home and ordered the match run again with Jack Murphy as referee. Divide And Conquer 2006 (pay-per-view), 23 June 2006: Mike Wade kicked out of Adam Dick's Eaterplex '05, then Dick reversed Wade's roll-up into a pin, with Jack Murphy as referee, to keep the Transatlantic Championship. Adam Dick threw the Transatlantic belt on the ground in front of Pearl and kept the crown as his own; the belt was left vacant and there was no match.

lost.source: The fed's write-up of Fresh! of 29 November 2005; the fed's own title history lists the change.

note: Jack Murphy pinned Butterfly Hamada, then Red Rock with a school-boy roll-up to take the Livewire Championship, and finished The British Bomber with the Fall From Grace to win the four way elimination match. A defence is on record. Fresh!, 22 November 2005: Jack Murphy hit Alexa Kendericks with a Bull Charge that sent her off the apron into the guardrail while Chainz held her leg, and she was counted out, so Murphy retained the Livewire Championship. Jack Murphy declared the Livewire belt his own Platinum Title, said no one could strip it, and dropped the Livewire championship at David Harber's feet; there was no match.

note: Johnny Lexicon broke up Jack Murphy's cover on AgentDash, hit Murphy with a DDT and then pinned AgentDash to win the Livewire Championship in a triple threat match. A defence is on record. Fresh!, 7 November 2006: Johnny Lexicon hit Blue Ruin with an elbow drop from the top rope and the Pattern Perfect for the third fall to retain the Livewire Championship in the first to three match.

Scott Taylor hit AgentDash with a charging super kick and pinned him, the first successful pin in the green triangle after Johnny Lexicon was disqualified, to win the Livewire Championship.

note: Vince Jones threw referee Richie Travis into Teresa Tomas in mid-air, hit her in the head with a baseball bat and covered her with Lars Larsson counting, to win the Countdown Trophy in the sudden death round. Defences on record. Fresh!east, 11 July 2006: Vince Jones stood over Leviathan, who was out cold beside a broken bat, and referee Aaron Davies counted the sudden-death fall, so Jones retained the Countdown Trophy. Fresh!west, 18 July 2006: Vince Jones hit Mikey O'Reilly with The Silencer, an inverted brainbuster, and pinned him before the time limit to retain the Countdown Trophy. Fresh!east, 25 July 2006: Vince Jones pinned Aimz, who was knocked out and bleeding, after Shawn Harris hit him with Natural Causes, to retain the Countdown Trophy. Fresh!special: Live On Huntington Beach, 1 August 2006: Garbage Bag Johnny burned Vince Jones out of the Ruby's Surf City Diner match with a flaming mop; Jones was still announced as the winner of the Countdown Trophy match and kept the trophy.

note: Chainz took the baseball bat from Jasmine, hit Vince Jones with it and then the Chain Reaction, two power bombs, and pinned him to win the Countdown Trophy. A defence is on record. Fresh!west, 15 August 2006: Chainz tapped to Teresa Tomas's Stretch Muffler only after the time-limit bell, and after Tracy Stanton hit Tomas in the back with a steel chair he pinned her with two power bombs to retain the Countdown Trophy.
